criteria.description: Graduate from a top business school or engineering school
criteria.compensation_description: Significant professional experience in strategy may compensate for the lack of a degree from a top school.

criteria.description: One or two significant internships in consulting (preferably in strategy), strategy department, investment banking / private equity, or financial analysis
criteria.compensation_description: Relevant professional experience in a related field may compensate for the lack of specific internships.

criteria.description: Fluency in English and French (oral and written)
criteria.compensation_description: A very advanced level in one language with a good level in the other may be considered.

criteria.description: Excellent oral and written communication skills

instructions.level: Limited evidence of good communication skills
Good communication skills demonstrated in some contexts
Excellent communication skills demonstrated in various contexts
Excellent analytical and synthesis skills with demonstrated examples

criteria.description: Ability to work with various levels of stakeholders and appreciate teamwork

instructions.level: Limited interpersonal skills or teamwork experience
Good interpersonal skills and teamwork experience
Excellent interpersonal skills and strong teamwork experience

criteria.description: Ability to work under pressure and prioritize tasks

instructions.level: Limited ability to handle pressure or prioritize
Good ability to handle pressure and prioritize tasks
Excellent ability to work under pressure with demonstrated prioritization skills

criteria.description: Proficiency with numbers and data analysis

instructions.level: Basic proficiency with numbers and data
Good proficiency with numbers and data analysis
Excellent proficiency with numbers and advanced data analysis skills

criteria.description: Initiative-taking and ability to gain autonomy

instructions.level: Limited evidence of initiative-taking or autonomy
Good evidence of initiative-taking and growing autonomy
Strong evidence of initiative-taking and high level of autonomy
